{{Quote|That's where Ossus is. Jedi get crystals from the Adega system to build their lightsabers... we have for hundreds of years.|[[Tau Idair]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Odessen}}</ref>}}
The '''Adega system''', also known as the '''Adegan system''', was one of the six remaining [[Auril systems]]. Located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], it was once a major center for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] activities. It contained two [[Star/Legends|suns]], [[Adega Prime]] and [[Adega Besh]], around which the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] in a figure-eight trajectory. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was once the main source of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]], used in the earliest Jedi [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], before the discovery of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

[[Bodo Baas]], later [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of the [[Tedryn Holocron]], was part of a Jedi band that lived there around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]]. [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]] was also from the system. Indigenous life in the system included the [[Adegan eel]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|PC game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] includes a planet named [[Adega]] among the game's playable worlds, which it places in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the Outer Rim.<ref name="SWR" />

''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in 2009 describes [[Adega]] as being a "world near Ossus," which would naturally seem to place it in the Adega system. However, despite this mention of Adega in the entry for Ilum, ''The Essential Atlas'' does not list it among the planets of the Adega system in the entry for Ossus.<ref name="TEA"/> [[Jason Fry]], author of ''The Essential Atlas'', confirmed the placement of Adega in the Adega system but was not able to provide an explanation for the discrepancy in the ''Atlas''.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2025.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-09-17}}</ref>
